description.it: La rosa del club scelto: età, abilità, valore e contratti.
description.en: The chosen club's squad: age, ability, value and contracts.

widgets.sql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club
SELECT round(avg(age), 1) AS value FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club
SELECT round(avg(ability_current), 1) AS value FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club
SELECT sum(transfer_value) AS value FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club
SELECT name, ability_current FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 20

widgets.label: name
widgets.sql: SELECT name, age, ability_current FROM players WHERE club_uid = :club

SELECT p.name, p.age, p.natural_positions AS positions, p.ability_current, p.ability_potential, p.transfer_value, c.wage, c."end" AS contract_end, c.squad_status_label AS squad_status FROM players p LEFT JOIN contracts c ON c.player_uid = p.uid WHERE p.club_uid = :club ORDER BY p.ability_current DESC
